items.title: Resolve the learning-store finding-signals cache from the main repo root (worktree-safe), read + write
items.context: In core/learning-store.ts (the only toucher of .lattice/learning/), resolve the learning directory to the MAIN repo root — the parent of `git rev-parse --git-common-dir` run in the given root — instead of the passed (possibly-worktree) root, for both reading and writing the finding-signals cache. Add a helper (e.g. resolveLearningRoot(root)) that runs git rev-parse --git-common-dir in `root`, resolves it to an absolute path, and returns its parent dir; on ANY failure (non-git dir, error, empty) FALL BACK to the passed root unchanged. All consumers (experience-hint-loader loadExperienceHints, learning_scan write, learning_validate, learning_effectiveness) inherit the fix via learning-store. Do not change the cache schema, the finding-signals derivation, or any gate. Keep the module leaf (no cross-module imports).
items.userSees: Running story_review inside a worktree (.worktrees/B-xxxx) now loads the main checkout’s finding-signals cache: hints surface in the _reviewPrompt section and an experience_hint_surfaced event is recorded (previously zero). learning_scan run from a worktree writes/updates the single main-checkout cache.

happy.desc: story_review / loadExperienceHints inside a worktree resolves and reads the main-checkout finding-signals cache (non-empty hints).

edge.desc: A non-git temp dir (or git failure) falls back to the passed root unchanged — no throw, empty when the cache is absent.
Read and write both use resolveLearningRoot so learning_scan write + later read agree on one canonical main cache (no split-brain).

adversarial.desc: git rev-parse --git-common-dir is run with cwd=root and resolved to an absolute parent, so the main root is correct from a worktree; the smoke asserts the worktree reads the MAIN cache path.
A cache-path resolution error never breaks story_review/learning_* (try/catch + fallback); advisory-only.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke: reading via the learning-store / loadExperienceHints FROM a linked worktree resolves and reads the main-checkout finding-signals cache (non-empty). Passed (4 checks).
Smoke: a non-git temp dir falls back to the passed root (resolveLearningRoot catch) — no throw, empty when the cache is absent.

resolveLearningDir funnels EVERY read+write path (finding-signals/playbooks/proposals/registry/log) through resolveLearningRoot, so write-then-read agree on one canonical main cache; smoke asserts write-parity.

resolveLearningRoot runs git rev-parse --git-common-dir with cwd=searchOrigin and dirname(resolve(searchOrigin, commonDir)) → the absolute main root; the smoke asserts the worktree reads the MAIN cache path. For the main checkout (.git) it is byte-identical to the old behavior.
resolveLearningRoot is try/catch with fallback to searchOrigin, so a git failure never breaks story_review / learning_*; advisory-only.

items.title: Smoke: hints load + experience_hint_surfaced fires from a worktree whose cache lives in the main checkout
items.context: Add a smoke (packages/main/src/tasks/*-smoke.ts, auto-discovered + npm wiring) that builds a main git repo with a finding-signals cache under main/.lattice/learning/, creates a linked worktree, and asserts that the learning-store/experience-hint-loader resolves and reads the cache from the worktree (hasExperienceHints true; loadExperienceHints non-empty) — and a control that a non-git temp dir falls back to the passed root (no throw, empty when absent). Prefer driving the real learning-store resolver. Confirm the existing experience-layer smokes (temp-root, non-git) still pass (fallback path).
items.userSees: node packages/main/dist/tasks/<smoke>.js prints its checks and exits 0; full npm test exits 0 with the new smoke in the chain; existing experience-layer/hint smokes stay green.

happy.desc: node packages/main/dist/tasks/experience-hint-worktree-cache-smoke.js exits 0 and reports all checks passed.

edge.desc: Full npm test exits 0 with the new smoke in the chain; existing experience-layer/hint smokes stay green.

adversarial.desc: The smoke drives the real learning-store resolver (worktree reads main cache; non-git falls back), not a stub.

verificationEvidence.note: Ran the smoke directly: exits 0 and prints "experience-hint-worktree-cache smoke passed (4 checks)".
Full npm test exits 0 (ALL PASS) with test:experience-hint-worktree-cache in the chain; existing experience-layer/hint smokes stay green.
The smoke drives the real learning-store resolver against a real git main+worktree and a non-git dir (not a stub); RED/GREEN verified (neutralizing the resolver fails 3/4 checks).
